answer_1.quote: We test BOOSTEDPROB on different tasks: Speech Translation (ST), Machine/Text Translation (MT), Summarization (Sum.), Question Answering (QA).

answer_2.quote: We use BART Score as pseudo ground-truth quality. The quality scores are calculated as the BART model probability of the output given the input text.

answer_3.quote: We also compare our approach against a recent baseline, LLM-as-a-Judge. ... we adapt it to an LLM self-judge setup, where the model is asked to assign a quality score to its own output.

answer_4.quote: We present these top tokens to human annotators, and ask them to annotate which tokens are valid output (details in Appendix A).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to mark which tokens in the dominant cluster are correct/valid outputs.
